title: Update VSCode Launch Configs

iterations.prompt: The vscode launch configs are outdated. All package commands should be available there. Make sure that all configs have test, test:unit, test:e2e, test:coverage. Reorder from specific first to general last. Consider the development lifecycle in the order (e.g. dev->test->build->publish:test->publish). Use a new naming style like @semio-repo/go build, @semio-repo/vscode build, @semio/js dev, etc.
